title: apistore.Serializer is the single extension point for encode/decode across write, read, list, watch
answers: where to plug in custom JSON encoding/decoding for a unified-storage resource
how does apistore decide to use the codec vs raw JSON for a resource
where is watch decoding's context propagation handled in apistore
what implements the Serializer interface for apistore storage
body:
pkg/storage/unified/apistore/serializer.go defines the `Serializer` interface (context-aware Encode/Decode) with two built-ins: `jsonSerializer` (direct JSON, preserves the object's own GVK, no scheme lookup) and `codecSerializer` (wraps a runtime.Codec; preserveGVK=true makes it behave like jsonSerializer for declared-GVK resources, matching pre-PR default behavior).
`StorageOptions.Serializer` (pkg/storage/unified/apistore/store.go:StorageOptions) lets a resource override the default; when nil, `NewStorage` builds a `codecSerializer{codec: config.Codec, preserveGVK: !opts.GVK.Empty()}`.
All Storage paths (prepareObjectForStorage/Update, reads, lists, watch decode) now go through `s.serializer` instead of a bare `s.codec`, and watch decoding keeps the request's context (including cancellation) rather than a detached one.
applies: anyone adding or changing resource storage behavior in pkg/storage/unified/apistore or callers via RESTOptionsGetter

search: The Serializer interface in apistore is the unified extension point for encode/decode across all Storage paths: prepareObjectForStorage, reads, lists, and watch decode—all now route through s.serializer instead of a bare codec. Two built-in implementations exist: jsonSerializer (preserves object's own GVK, no scheme lookup) and codecSerializer (wraps runtime.Codec with optional preserveGVK=true for GVK preservation); StorageOptions.Serializer allows per-resource override, defaulting to codecSerializer with preserveGVK based on opts.GVK. Watch decoding now preserves the request's context including cancellation rather than using a detached context. This guidance applies to tasks involving custom resource storage behavior in pkg/storage/unified/apistore or callers using RESTOptionsGetter. Key symbols: Serializer interface, codecSerializer, jsonSerializer, StorageOptions, NewStorage.
